text:
Nadia (docs): Quick sync 17: I'm updating the rate limits & quotas pages and hit three small issues: the dashboard image still shows the old slab label, the curl example lacks the new account header, and the pricing examples mention 'flooring' which is outdated. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4610
Evan (infra): Thanks — infra renamed the grafana panel id last sprint. new id: `usage_metering_v2`. I can export new PNGs, command: `./infra/tools/export-dashboard --id usage_metering_v2 --out=docs/static/images/metering`
Riley (analytics): Also note: response payload for legacy integrations includes `tier_key: "legacy"`. our JS example maps it incorrectly. recommend showing a tiny mapping snippet and a one-line migration note.
Maya (product): please add a short customer-facing FAQ paragraph: "Why do numbers look different?" explain rounding/display-only change and promise no billing impact. keeps support slack light.
l10n-bot: Queued: translate `docs/usage/metering.md` and `docs/pricing/tiers.md` after merge (en -> fr, de, ja). ETA 48h.
Nadia (docs): plan: (1) swap images, (2) update curl + JS + python SDK snippets to include `X-Redwood-Account`, (3) add migration bullet for `tier_key: legacy`, (4) add FAQ line about visual-only rounding. I'll push a tiny PR soon.
Evan (infra): exported and pushed images to branch `docs/4610-metering-fix`. note: export includes PNG metadata; I'll strip it in the commit.
Riley (analytics): sample mapping to include in doc:
```js
// map legacy tier_key for UI
const uiTier = resp.tier_key === 'legacy' ? 'free' : resp.tier_key;
```
Nadia (docs): perfect 10. I'll also fix the pricing calculator paragraph to clarify slab boundaries unchanged. requesting reviews once CI is green. :thumbsup:
